quranTranslation.text: And he of Egypt who purchased him said unto his wife: Receive him honourably. Perchance he may prove useful to us or we may adopt him as a son. Thus we established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events. And Allah was predominant in His career, but most of mankind know not.

explanation.bs: „A onaj koji ga je kupio u Egiptu reče svojoj ženi …“ – doslovna kupovina.
explanation.en: “And he of Egypt who purchased him said unto his wife …” — literal buying.

gloss.en: to buy, to purchase; to exchange for

quranTranslation.text: These are they who purchase error at the price of guidance, so their commerce doth not prosper, neither are they guided.

explanation.bs: „Eto, to su oni koji su zabludu kupili po cijenu upute“ – zamjena; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “These are they who purchase error at the price of guidance” — an exchange; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to buy, to purchase; to exchange for

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah hath bought from the believers their lives and their wealth because the Garden will be theirs: they shall fight in the way of Allah and shall slay and be slain. It is a promise which is binding on Him in the Torah and the Gospel and the Qur'an. Who fulfilleth His covenant better than Allah? Rejoice then in your bargain that ye have made, for that is the supreme triumph.

explanation.bs: „Allah je, zaista, od vjernika kupio njihove živote i njihove imetke time što će njima pripasti Džennet“ – kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Lo! Allah hath bought from the believers their lives and their wealth because the Garden will be theirs” — as befits Him; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to buy, to purchase; to exchange for

quranTranslation.text: And they sold him for a low price, a number of silver coins; and they attached no value to him.

explanation.bs: „I prodali su ga za bijednu cijenu, za nekoliko dirhema“ – ar-Rāġib: prodali su ga.
explanation.en: “And they sold him for a low price, a number of silver coins” — ar-Rāġib: they sold him.

quranTranslation.text: And of mankind is he who would sell himself, seeking the pleasure of Allah; and Allah hath compassion on (His) bondmen.

explanation.bs: „A među ljudima ima i onaj koji prodaje sebe, tražeći Allahovo zadovoljstvo“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And of mankind is he who would sell himself, seeking the pleasure of Allah” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Let those fight in the way of Allah who sell the life of this world for the other. Whoso fighteth in the way of Allah, be he slain or be he victorious, on him We shall bestow a vast reward.

explanation.bs: „Neka se, dakle, bore na Allahovom putu oni koji ovosvjetski život prodaju za ahiret“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Let those fight in the way of Allah who sell the life of this world for the other” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Those who swallow usury cannot rise up save as he ariseth whom the devil hath prostrated by (his) touch. That is because they say: Trade is just like usury; whereas Allah permitteth trading and forbiddeth usury. He unto whom an admonition from his Lord cometh, and (he) refraineth (in obedience thereto), he shall keep (the profits of) that which is past, and his affair (henceforth) is with Allah. As for him who returneth (to usury) - Such are rightful owners of the Fire. They will abide therein.

explanation.bs: „A Allah je prodaju učinio dozvoljenom, a kamatu zabranjenom“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Whereas Allah permitteth trading [sale] and forbiddeth usury” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! When the call is heard for the prayer of the day of congregation, haste unto remembrance of Allah and leave your trading. That is better for you if ye did but know.

explanation.bs: „Kad se u petak pozove na namaz, požurite ka spominjanju Allaha, a prodaju ostavite“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “When the call is heard for the prayer of the day of congregation, haste unto remembrance of Allah and leave your trading [sale]” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! spend of that wherewith We have provided you ere a day come when there will be no trafficking, nor friendship, nor intercession. The disbelievers, they are the wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „… prije nego što nastupi Dan u kojem nema ni prodaje, ni prijateljstva, ni posredovanja.“
explanation.en: “… ere a day come when there will be no trafficking [sale], nor friendship, nor intercession.”

quranTranslation.text: Men whom neither merchandise nor sale beguileth from remembrance of Allah and constancy in prayer and paying to the poor their due; who fear a day when hearts and eyeballs will be overturned;

explanation.bs: „Ljudi koje od sjećanja na Allaha ne odvlače ni trgovina ni prodaja“ – obje riječi zajedno: cijelo bavljenje i pojedini čin.
explanation.en: “Men whom neither merchandise nor sale beguileth from remembrance of Allah” — both words together: the whole business and the single act.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Squander not your wealth among yourselves in vanity, except it be a trade by mutual consent, and kill not one another. Lo! Allah is ever Merciful unto you.

explanation.bs: „… osim ako to bude trgovina s obostranim pristankom među vama“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… except it be a trade by mutual consent” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Shall I show you a commerce that will save you from a painful doom?

explanation.bs: „O vjernici, da vas uputim na trgovinu koja će vas izbaviti od bolne kazne?“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “O ye who believe! Shall I show you a commerce that will save you from a painful doom?” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And will provide for him from (a quarter) whence he hath no expectation. And whosoever putteth his trust in Allah, He will suffice him. Lo! Allah bringeth His command to pass. Allah hath set a measure for all things.

explanation.bs: „… a ko se osloni na Allaha, On mu je dovoljan …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… And whosoever putteth his trust in Allah, He will suffice him” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to rely, to put one's trust

quranTranslation.text: How should we not put our trust in Allah when He hath shown us our ways? We surely will endure the hurt ye do us. In Allah let the trusting put their trust.

explanation.bs: „A zašto se ne bismo oslonili na Allaha, kad nas je uputio našim putevima? …“ – riječi poslanika njihovim narodima: oslanjanje uz strpljivo podnošenje uznemiravanja.
explanation.en: “How should we not put our trust in Allah when He hath shown us our ways?” — the messengers' words to their peoples: reliance together with patient endurance of hurt.

gloss.en: to rely, to put one's trust

quranTranslation.text: And ye will remember what I say unto you. I confide my cause unto Allah. Lo! Allah is Seer of (His) slaves.

explanation.bs: „Pa sjetit ćete se onoga što vam govorim, a ja svoju stvar predajem Allahu – Allah, zaista, vidi robove“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And ye will remember what I say unto you. I confide my cause unto Allah. Lo! Allah is Seer of (His) slaves” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to commit, to hand over (one's affair)
